description: This file defines the GeoServices class which provides geographic utility functions, notably calculating the distance between two geographical points using the Haversine formula.

classes.name: GeoServices
classes.description: A utility class providing geographic-related services, including calculating distances between geo points.

methods.name: getDistanceBetweenGeoPoints
methods.description: Calculates the distance between two geographic points specified in the context map, returning the result in kilometers or miles based on locale.
